objective: Test whether Muon-family updates trade smaller mean one-step margin gains for fewer severe per-query regressions, and whether that tail-stability signature survives three-seed scale-matched shared-start training.

discovery_diagnostic.quantile_definition: linear interpolation at index (n-1)q after stable ascending sort

primary_tail_metrics.loss: p95 of per-query contrastive-loss change from the same unmodified baseline; lower is better
primary_tail_metrics.margin: p05 of per-query positive-minus-hardest-negative margin change from the same baseline; higher is better

discovery_diagnostic.secondary_tail_metric: p99 of per-query contrastive-loss change; lower is better
discovery_diagnostic.tradeoff_definition: challenger minus AdamW mean margin is negative while challenger minus AdamW p95 loss is negative and p05 margin is non-negative

secondary_discovery_diagnostic.objective: Distinguish uniform suppression of the same fragile-query tail from redistribution to a different set of worst queries.
secondary_discovery_diagnostic.selection_rule: For each operator and anchor, select the ceil(0.05 * 224) largest per-query contrastive-loss changes, breaking exact ties by ascending sample_id.
symmetric_comparisons: challenger minus AdamW loss change on the AdamW-selected worst tail
challenger minus AdamW loss change on the challenger-selected worst tail
Jaccard overlap between the two selected tails
median baseline-margin midrank percentile of the AdamW-selected tail
secondary_discovery_diagnostic.interpretation_rule: Negative challenger-minus-AdamW means on both symmetrically selected tails indicate severity suppression on a largely shared failure set; a negative contrast only on the AdamW-selected tail indicates redistribution to different worst queries. This classification is exploratory and was defined after the preliminary cross-tail values were visible.

unseen_metrics.pretrained_top1_agreement: fraction retaining the pretrained top-1 candidate
unseen_metrics.pretrained_score_drift_rms: RMS candidate-score drift from the pretrained reference

short_branch_confirmation.primary_final_stage_rule: For each family and challenger, support requires the three-seed median challenger-minus-scale-matched-AdamW contrast to be negative for query-disjoint loss p95 and positive for unseen margin p05. Mixed signs are reported as mixed and cannot support the tail-stability account.

amendments.reason: Add a symmetric worst-tail identity diagnostic after inspecting its preliminary discovery values; preserve the already-frozen three-seed confirmation rule unchanged.

claim_boundary: The discovery tail analysis is explicitly post hoc and can only describe a mean-tail tradeoff at fixed weights. The frozen short-branch rule is prospective relative to all three-seed shared-start outcomes and can test whether the signature persists under accumulated training, but even a positive result would not prove that tail stability alone mediates full-corpus BEIR gains.
